message:
We were sitting around the dinner table the other night, and I couldn’t help but bring up the go-bags we had put together a while back. My partner rolled their eyes, remembering my insistence on having them ready. 

But when a storm warning popped up later that evening, there was a little smugness in my voice as I pointed to the bags tucked away by the door. It was a light-hearted moment, but it reminded us both how simple preparations can turn into peace of mind. 

Sometimes, it feels good to be the ‘I told you so’ person, doesn’t it? 😊
